moments.text: Infrared sensor view over a mottled grey background, crosshair at centre on a dark round spot. Black boxes mask parts of the edges.
The dark spot narrows into an upright oval while the sensor keeps it on the crosshair and the background drifts past.
The spot rounds out again into a dark blob with a soft grey halo, still centred on the crosshair.
The spot stretches into a tilted oval, upper end leaning right, and stays on the crosshair until the clip ends.
